name: Connected Conditioning-Minimal Non-Ample Classes
summary: Conditioning-minimal non-ample classes whose one-inclusion graphs are connected; equivalently, tope graphs of non-free simple uniform oriented matroids.
comments: Connectedness removes exactly the two-concept parallel rank-one exception from the full conditioning-minimal non-ample class. Every member has at least three concepts and an irredundant isometric hypercube embedding. The class is neither p-closed nor c-closed, and hence is not pc-closed: sufficiently small projections are cubes, while every nonempty proper conditioning is an ample UOM fiber. These full UOM tope sets are the nontrivial parents whose proper topal fibers belong to UOMFib; the parents are non-ample and therefore are not themselves UOMFib members.
